description.text: An enhanced expansion pack released on 13 September 2024 with many Dragon Pokémon, made for sealed play. Alolan Exeggutor ex of the Stellar Tera Type leads it: its attack does 150 damage and attaches any number of basic Energy from the hand to its player's Pokémon. Latias ex, Flygon ex, Archaludon ex, Black Kyurem ex and Cyclizar ex join it, with the Supporters Drayton, Lisia's Appeal and Surfer and the ACE SPEC cards Energy Search PRO, Megaton Blower and Enriching Energy. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 64, followed by Art Rare Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex and Supporters, Special Art Rare cards, among them a Latias ex that pairs with the Art Rare Latios as the two glide over a harbour town at dusk, and gold Ultra Rare Alolan Exeggutor ex, Counter Gain and Jet Energy. In English most of its cards came out in Surging Sparks in November 2024.
